description: Unit test code for quic::quic_packets, testing packet header creation, connection ID retrieval, copying headers and serialized packets within the quic namespace.

classes.name: QuicPacketsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for quic packet tests, inherits from QuicTest.

methods.name: CreateFakePacketHeader
methods.description: Creates a fake QuicPacketHeader with preset connection IDs and inclusion flags.

methods.name: GetServerConnectionIdAsRecipient
methods.description: Retrieves server connection ID as recipient based on header and perspective.

methods.name: GetServerConnectionIdAsSender
methods.description: Retrieves server connection ID as sender based on header and perspective.

methods.name: GetServerConnectionIdIncludedAsSender
methods.description: Checks if server connection ID is included when sending, based on perspective.

methods.name: GetClientConnectionIdIncludedAsSender
methods.description: Checks if client connection ID is included when sending, based on perspective.

methods.name: GetClientConnectionIdAsRecipient
methods.description: Retrieves client connection ID as recipient based on header and perspective.

methods.name: GetClientConnectionIdAsSender
methods.description: Retrieves client connection ID as sender based on header and perspective.

methods.name: CopyQuicPacketHeader
methods.description: Copies a QuicPacketHeader, testing copy constructor and equality.

methods.name: CopySerializedPacket
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SerializedPacket, optionally copying buffer data.
